enchantments.tooltip: +15 Enhancement Bonus: +15 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Exceptional Alluring Skills Bonus: +11 Exceptional bonus to Bluff, Diplomacy, Haggle, Intimidate, and Perform.
Felling the Oak: On a natural 20 that is confirmed as a critical hit, this weapon will trip your opponent, forcing them to fall prone. There is no save against this effect.
Coruscating 7: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to coruscate, dealing 7d6 Light damage on each hit.
Electrifying 7: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to arc with electricity, dealing 7d6 Lightning damage on each hit.
Blazing 16: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to coruscate, dealing 16d6 Light damage on each critical hit.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
